T8_entry: Just past the blind crest (s 2454, the road's highest point here). Judge the drop after the crest (grade -6 %) and the 12.2 m width against both frames. The real cars are still at the LEFT edge here: the yellow kerb on the left (s 2451-2466) is just behind them. The solver's line (second still) is already right of centre. The left edge sits on the asphalt, with grass beyond it and no paved run-off.
T8_apex: The red/white apex kerb on the right lies outside the race edge (your inner-kerb convention). Judge where it starts (about s 2505) and how long it runs. Judge the road widening to 13.4 m at the apex: do the frames show the same widening? Judge the dip into the compression. The 360 car and N837 both have their right wheels at this kerb.
T8_exit: The road narrows back to 12 m. The yellow exit kerb on the left starts at about s 2565, and the 360 car is on it at s 2582. T9 (right) is ahead. Judge the kerb start, the width, and the slight downhill before T9's climb.
T4_entry: The braking zone into the 2024 rebuild. Judge the bank (the rule halved it, 2.2 deg at the peak; the frames look nearly level), the width, the turn-in point and the right apex kerb ahead. The autopilot's left wheel goes off 70 m before this point (s 1861-1871). The real cars brake about 1-1.5 m from the left line (the 200 and 100 boards are on the left).
T4_apex: Judge the apex kerb on the right (kept in the 2024 rebuild) and its length, the bank under the car against the frames, and the outside (left) edge. N837 t065 carries a YouTube end-screen overlay, so judge from the 360 still.
T4_exit: The exit onto the short run to Madness. Judge the yellow exit kerb on the left (the 360 still, s ~2008) and where it starts, and the road's fall toward Madness.
T13_T1: Pit straight midpoint. Judge that both edges run straight (your round-2 red), the width, and the grade. The pit wall, stands and gantry are scenery and are not built yet.
T1_entry: Just past the Firestone footbridge (s 233; the bridge is scenery). Judge the start of the raised red/white inside kerb on the left (s 285; the pit exit is beyond it), with the race edge on its asphalt side, and the width at the pit-exit merge.
T1_apex: Judge the inside kerb on the left (s 285-360) against both frames: its length, and the edge on its asphalt side. Judge the start of the yellow exit kerb on the right (s 365).
T1_exit: The yellow T1 exit kerb on the right (s 365-480). The race edge is on its track side. Judge the kerb's line and the width. The unused joining road on the right is a green-stroke surface, not course.
T1_T2: The straight from T1 to the Keyhole. Judge the edges, the width and the gentle grade. The paved variants on the side are green strokes and are not driven.
T2_entry: Braking for the Keyhole. Judge the apex kerb on the right ahead, the width, and the outside edge. Paved variants beside the course are green strokes and are not driven.
T2_apex: The Keyhole apex kerb on the right. Judge the constant arc (centre R 43 m) against the frames, and the outside edge.
T2_exit: The yellow exit kerb on the left (s 1010-1120), track side. Judge its start and line as the back straight opens.
T2_T3: Between the Keyhole and T3. Judge the long straight's edges, its width and its climb.
T3_entry: T3 is the R 300 kink to the right, taken flat out. Judge where the bend starts and how sharp it looks against the frames. (N837 has one frame for the entry and apex: t052.)
T3_apex: The T3 kink at its sharpest point. Judge the bend and the width, and whether any kerb shows in the frames.
T3_exit: Out of T3 onto the back straight. Judge the edges, the width, and the brake boards ahead (scenery).
T3_T4: The back straight (the fastest point, ~170 km/h in the sim). Judge that the edges run straight, the width, and the gentle fall toward T4.
T5_entry: Madness at the bottom of the descent from T4. Judge the left apex kerb ahead, the dip, and the width.
T5_apex: The Madness apex kerb on the left. Judge where it starts and its length, and the climb out after it.
T5_exit: The Madness exit. Judge whatever kerbs the frames show at the exit, and the short run to T6.
T6_entry: The T6 right-hander. Judge the apex kerb on the right, the grade, and the width.
T6_apex: The T6 apex kerb on the right. The real cars use it: round 5 found T6-T7 slow because the line stays 1 m inside the race edge. Judge the kerb width and its line.
T6_exit: Out of T6 toward T7. Judge the left edge and the climb.
T7_entry: The T7 left-hander, going up the hill to T8. Judge the yellow kerb on the left (both frames) and its start.
T7_apex: The T7 apex at the left edge. The real cars put their left wheels on the yellow kerb. Judge the kerb and the climb to the crest (s 2454).
T7_exit: The climb toward the blind crest (s 2454). Judge the rise (+7 %), where the road disappears over the brow, and the width.
T9_entry: T9 (right) after T8. Judge the apex kerb on the right (s ~2625-2690), the climb, and the sand trap outside on the left (scenery).
T9_apex: The T9 apex kerb on the right. Judge its length and the constant radius against the frames.
T9_exit: Out of T9 toward Thunder Valley. Judge the edges, the width and the crest before the drop.
T10_entry: Down into Thunder Valley; the PERMCO footbridge is behind at s 2836 (scenery). Judge the dip's depth against the frames, and the width.
T10_apex: Thunder Valley, the long R 150 right. Judge the bend at the bottom of the valley and the start of the climb.
T10_exit: The climb out of Thunder Valley toward T11. Judge the grade and the edges.
T11_entry: T11 (left) at the top of the climb. Judge any kerb the frames show, and the grade.
T11_apex: The T11 apex. Judge the radius, the inside (left) edge against any kerb in the frames, and the right edge.
T11_exit: Out of T11 toward the Carousel. Judge the edges and the width.
T12_entry: Into the Carousel (a long right). Judge where the apex kerb on the right starts, and the width.
T12_apex: The Carousel apex. Judge the right kerb, the constant radius, and the outside (left) edge.
T12_exit: The Carousel exit. Judge the kerb on the right, and the T13 left ahead.
T13_entry: T13 (left) onto the pit straight. Judge the apex kerb on the left, and the pit-entry split on the right (your round-2 red).
T13_apex: The T13 apex kerb on the left. Judge its start, and the pit-entry edge on the right.
T13_exit: Onto the pit straight. Judge both edges (your round-2 red) through the transition.
